description: You are a telecommunications network engineer. An incomplete enterprise network topology diagram has been started and saved at ~/Diagrams/enterprise_network.drawio. The file currently contains only the WAN edge layer (two ISP connections and border routers). Review the requirements document at ~/Desktop/network_requirements.txt, then complete the diagram by adding all missing network layers: the core switching layer, the distribution switching layer, and the access switching layer. Use draw.io's built-in network/Cisco shape libraries to represent each device with the correct icon. Apply standard hierarchical network color-coding: gold for WAN, blue for core, green for distribution, orange for access. Label each inter-layer link with the interface type and capacity (e.g., '40Gbps / OSPF'). Create a second diagram page named 'OOB Management' containing the out-of-band management network topology (console server, management switch, and management connections to all routers and core switches). When complete, export the full diagram as a PDF to ~/Diagrams/enterprise_network.pdf. Login: username ga, password password123.
